scientific_integrity: Cauchy stationarity is independently reconstructed; the stationary moment theorem is analytically proved and finite checks are identified as consistency tests, not certification of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: One-sided invariant-measure asymptotics for fixed N≥2 on the stated parameter branch; no time-correlation, ergodicity, or joint N limit is asserted. Invariant density and parameterization belong to the 2000 source.
title: Critical moment freezing and logarithmic crossover in a rational Chebyshev family
